source_context: The human operator asked GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT to continue developing useful LeanFrontier machinery toward eventual work on the Frobenius/Markov uniqueness conjecture. After reconciling overlapping work around existence of square roots of -1, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected a more orientation-sensitive invariant: for an oriented node with Markov-number coordinate M and complementary coordinates u,v, define the quotient u/v in ZMod |M|. Pairwise coprimality makes the denominator invertible and Markov sum-square divisibility gives u^2+v^2=0 modulo |M|, so this quotient squares to -1. The module also proves that swapping u and v replaces the quotient by its multiplicative inverse. This packages node-specific arithmetic data that can distinguish orientations even when the bare existence of a square root cannot. It does not prove any case of Markov uniqueness. GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT selected the target and authored all definitions, statements, and proofs; the human did not choose or materially edit them. No claim of new mathematics is made.
